subject: E-Commerce
title: eBay's Reinvention Struggle
description: A quick, practical guide to eBay's Reinvention Struggle.

hook.text: eBay once rivaled Amazon. Now it has 4% of US e-commerce vs Amazon's 38%. The pioneer became an afterthought.

buildup.text: eBay defined online shopping in the 2000s. Auctions, PayPal, and collectibles were its identity.

discovery.text: eBay pivoted to focus on luxury authentication, sneakers, and collectibles—niches where trust and expertise matter.

twist.text: eBay's authentication service for sneakers and handbags grew 300%. Finding a niche may be its survival strategy.

climax.text: eBay can't beat Amazon at everything, so it's becoming the best at specific things. Niche beats scale when done right.

punchline.text: 38% vs 4%. The marketplace pioneer survives by finding niches the giant ignores.

quiz.question: How is eBay reinventing itself to compete in the marketplace wars?
options: Focusing on authenticated luxury, sneakers, and collectibles where trust matters
